proposed_sample.threshold: all unrounded two-sided 95% calibrated CI lower bounds strictly > 2000 Elo
proposed_sample.controls: both registered null controls and thresholds unchanged

historical_vs_amended_arithmetic.sharding: 50 shards × 2 games per anchor/batch; one matrix wave under 256

opening_suites.selector: Python hashlib SHA-256 over the domain-separated normalized original opening line; choose the 50 smallest hexadecimal digests lexicographically, then retain historical order.

screening_inputs.note: These are selection-only screening inputs, not confirmation evidence or a rating estimate.

published_calibration.source: frozen benches/anchor-pool.json; published error convention is ci95
published_calibration.conversion: published 95% CI half-width divided by 1.96 to place calibration errors on the SD scale
published_calibration.cross_batch_treatment: same calibration draw is shared across Batch A and Batch B; only match-noise is independently drawn between disjoint batches

prospective_sensitivity.method: delta-method multivariate-normal sensitivity simulation; 250000 Monte Carlo replicates per scenario
prospective_sensitivity.final_evidence_method: actual gate remains the registered opening-cluster bootstrap with joint cluster resampling, GLS, calibration uncertainty propagation and shared cross-batch calibration

covariance_model.anchors_1_and_2: empirical SD and paired-opening correlation from the deterministic Batch A 50-opening subset
covariance_model.anchor_3: marginal opening-cluster SD assumed equal to the larger of the two measured SDs

prospective_sensitivity.batch_b_assumption: match-noise distribution assumed exchangeable with Batch A, with independent match-noise because opening suites are disjoint; this cannot be empirically checked from current evidence
prospective_sensitivity.interpretation: At a true rating only 100 Elo above the threshold, estimated probability of clearing all three independent lower-bound requirements ranges about 63–77% with no variance inflation and falls to about 9–23% under 1.5–2× cluster SD stress. The design is much better powered at larger margins, but the actual margin and key covariance inputs are unknown.

blocking_reasons: No complete cluster-level distribution for the third mechanically selected anchor is yet available.
The disjoint Batch B 50-opening suite has no screening distribution; its exchangeability with Batch A is assumed rather than measured.
The power result depends strongly on the unknown true margin above 2000 and the unmeasured third-anchor correlations; near-threshold alternatives fail the desired power levels.
The prospective simulation is a delta-method normal approximation, not the actual registered bootstrap on future data.
decision: Keep 100-game design non-dispatchable. Do not claim PASS, do not run confirmatory games, and do not weaken sample size, the 40/15 time control, CI threshold, anchor rule or null controls. The 100-game design may only be run as explicitly exploratory if separately authorized; continue independent engineering work.
